title: Research: Q8 mixed targets retain four-call minimum through one extra role
body:
## Result

Adds `research/q8-mixed-three-register-seedcbd5ebc4/`, an exact scoped result in the formal group algebra `F2[Q8]`. For the 36 ordered diagonal triples with positive `{i,j}` word-length profile `(2,1,1)`, the exact local minimum is four paid rank-one calls at `r=3` and `r=4`. A three-call construction would save one call (25%) relative to the direct word; no such construction exists in the enumerated domains.

There is a uniform argument for the 24 triples whose length-two entry is `k` or `-k`: quotienting by the commutator subgroup gives first-order coefficient ranks `1+n_i` and `1+n_j`, where `n_i+n_j=2`. Each paid `i` or `j` factor contributes a rank-one matrix, so the total call count is at least four for every finite role count `r >= 3`. The other 12 triples have central entry `-1`; the same first-order invariant is insufficient, so this package claims the four-call minimum for those only at `r=3` and `r=4`, by exact search.

## Exact search and cost

The complete paid alphabet consists of both labels `i,j` and every binary rank-one idempotent: 56 factors at `r=3` and 240 at `r=4`. Formal group-algebra equality is represented by eight-bit coefficient masks. The search covers all exact depth-one and depth-two states and streams every depth-three extension of each distinct depth-two state, checking all 36 target matrices. Counts are in `EXPECTED.json` and recomputed by `verify.py`.

Each target has a direct four-call upper bound. The verifier includes a two-call positive control, full-convolution cross-checks against the optimized rank-one update, direct replay of all 36 targets, and dropped-call/wrong-target controls. Free scalar `GL_r(F2)` mixing is already covered because conjugation permutes the full rank-one-idempotent alphabet; augmentation forces any terminal scalar map to be the identity.

This is a local formal call count. An additional dirty role has no paid calls in this model, but its physical storage/hosting cost is not priced. The selected bit supplier remains nonbinding, and no supplier placement, finite-size runtime, or kappa improvement is claimed.

## Scope, pins, and overlap

The nearest predecessor is [PR #1822](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1822), by navinor, head `ee736b4b11bbd63b04d94c8edafb3790161ebdea`. It studies a two-role repeated central-commutator target; this package changes to three mixed generator/product targets and checks one additional arbitrary dirty role. It imports no predecessor code. The final complete overlap refresh at 2026-10-14T13:57:45Z covered 573 open PRs and 542 Discussions with no warnings; it found this package's own Discussion #1167 claim, but no remote same-scope claim. Other nearby bit results use distinct targets or groups: Discussion #1727 and PR #1716/#1763/Discussion #1774 use AGL2, Discussion #1759 uses UT4, and Discussion #1818 uses D16.

The maintainer-reviewed selected result remains conditional finite and complex-binding at `836330098538459/500000000000000000`. Its review, selected-source manifest, assembly certificate (SHA-256 `1122cb3a575f8c788345fc1bf4c108ac7c3250fb81a5988671f5eb04b3ab3045`), and `make frontier1094-verify` reproduction are pinned in `SOURCES.json`; the selected assembly was not rerun because none of its inputs changed.

Coordination claim and result: [Discussion #1167 comment](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1167#discussioncomment-18925071).

- `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -I -B research/q8-mixed-three-register-seedcbd5ebc4/verify.py` passes both role counts and the algebraic split.
- `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/q8-mixed-three-register-seedcbd5ebc4 --check-only` passes source pins and package metadata.
- Local environment: CPython 3.14.7; Python 3.12 is unavailable. The registered package runner specifies Python 3.12, so its replay was not run locally.
